decisions.question: S124 reports three topic-model@v1 contract gaps: G15 and G24's 'never contains the payload's own rendering' cannot hold for a very short rendering; G15's redaction of an already-redacted envelope wraps it again and loses the payload type; 'Everything here is a value or a total function' (topic-model line 18, nidana.model's Pure band) is inaccurate. Stop for hsdd-contract before implementing?

options.label: Implement G15 and G24 as written; route the three to the end-of-node governance sweep
options.consequence: nidana.model.8 delivers the guarantees verbatim; the wording fixes (compatible within v1) and the re-redaction rule wait for the sweep, before any consumer node.

options.label: Insert an hsdd-contract step now
options.consequence: Settles the re-redaction rule first; a governance step for wording that changes no case the gate replays.

decisions.chosen: Implement G15 and G24 as written; route the three to the end-of-node governance sweep
decisions.why: The plan follows the contract text and the conformance cases pass under it; the gaps are wording (compatible) and one rule choice that hsdd-contract owns. No consumer phase runs before the sweep.
